description: Expert-thinking profile for Mathematical Analyst (proof-theoretic / PDE & functional analysis / harmonic analysis / operator spectral theory / symbolic-numerical (SymPy, FEniCS, Lean)): Reasons from function-space topology, convergence modes, and constant- dependent inequalities (Hölder, Sobolev, Gronwall) through compactness theorems (Rellich-Kondrachov, Banach-Alaoglu), Calderon-Zygmund and Schauder estimates, and Lax-Milgram while treating limit-integral swaps without dominated convergence...
